description: This file implements the task execution management system, including creation and control of various execution contexts such as single workers, worker pools, and prioritized multi-queue workers. It manages the lifecycle of executors and execution contexts, supporting different queue policies and configurations.

classes.name: common_task_execution_context
classes.description: Template class providing shared functionality for different worker types, managing executor creation, storage, and lifecycle.

classes.name: single_worker_context
classes.description: Template class for single worker execution context, supporting different queue policies and wait strategies.

classes.name: worker_pool_context
classes.description: Template class for worker pool execution context with a single queue policy.

classes.name: priority_worker_pool_context
classes.description: Class for prioritized worker pool execution context supporting multiple queues.

classes.name: priority_multiqueue_worker_context
classes.description: Class for prioritized multi-queue worker context.

classes.name: task_execution_manager
classes.description: Manages multiple task execution contexts, allowing addition, removal, and stopping of contexts and their executors.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods for creating various execution contexts based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: add_execution_context
methods.description: Adds a new execution context to the manager, ensuring unique names and managing associated executors.
